people.name: Strahd von Zarovich
people.who: The vampire lord of Barovia killed Kolyan in a duel, took Ireena at Berez, and later received the party as guests at Ravenloft. The party saw Vampyr rebuke him in the Amber Temple.

people.name: Ireena Kolyana
people.who: Kolyan's daughter travelled with the party while seeking safety from Strahd. The party learned of her connection to Tatyana and last saw her at Ravenloft in a red dress.

people.name: Kolyan Indirovich
people.who: The burgomaster of Barovia village separated the sunlight from the Sunsword as part of a bargain to protect Ireena. Strahd killed him in single combat and returned his body to her.

people.name: Ismark
people.who: Kolyan's son asked the party to help retake the mansion from Antoni and his werewolves. He took charge of the village and promised to help the party in return.

people.name: Father Donavich
people.who: The village priest tried to keep the party away from his vampire son, Doru. Zarcharus struck him down in the church.

people.name: Doru
people.who: Donavich's son had rebelled against Strahd and was returned to his father as a vampire. He attacked Gurn in the church and was killed in the fight.

people.name: Rahadin
people.who: Strahd's chamberlain intervened at Old Bonegrinder, delivered the dinner invitation, and later fatally wounded Gurn in the crypts. The party saw him training a young Strahd in the Tome.

people.name: Escher
people.who: The vampire who introduced himself as Esha delivered Strahd's letter for Kolyan. At Mount Baratok he offered a bargain, then fought the party and was killed by Roger.

people.name: Anastrasya
people.who: The consort who stripped St. Andral's of its protection fought the party at the Vallaki circus and the burgomaster's mansion. Roger killed her with his final strike.

people.name: Ludmilla
people.who: The party encountered Ludmilla as one of Strahd's consorts. She privately offered Azza help against Strahd and gave him a way to contact her, but later fought the party and reduced Hrulek to ash.

people.name: Volenta
people.who: A consort and werewolf pack leader who killed Zarr on the road to Vallaki. The party later fought her at the Seeker's hill, where she took the form of a giant werewolf.

people.name: Vasili
people.who: The party met Vasili as a helpful traveller and guide. At Berez, they saw Strahd reveal himself while wearing Vasili's guise.

people.name: Morgantha
people.who: The pie seller known as Old Nan lived at the windmill with her daughters. After the coven attacked the party, Rahadin captured her and Zarcharus killed her.

people.name: Madam Eva
people.who: The Vistani seer read the party's cards and showed them a future in which their mistrust tore them apart. The party later learned she was the Weaver.

people.name: The Huntress
people.who: The Huntress reached Azza and Zarcharus in dreams and asked for help restoring her fane. The party saw her protection return when Azza channelled the hill.

people.name: The Seeker
people.who: The Seeker let Hrulek through the fog after he spoke a truth he wished were false. She gave him a cloak that could reveal a creature's vulnerabilities, resistances, and immunities.

people.name: DealsInLuck
people.who: The power that helped Gurn survive Death House marked him and offered to trade in luck and souls. It told him it wanted Strahd gone and asked him to gather power through his bargain.

people.name: Father Lucien
people.who: The priest at St. Andral's offered Ireena shelter and told the party that the church had lost its protection. The party later heard that he had been killed.

people.name: Urwin Martikov
people.who: The Blue Water Inn's host told the party about the Keepers of the Feather and challenged them to show they meant to free Barovia.

people.name: Lady Fiona Wachter
people.who: The Vallaki noble offered the party property and titles for helping remove the burgomaster. She later agreed to put her resources behind an independent Vallaki under Elliot.

people.name: Elliot
people.who: Elliot ran the party's estate, organised resistance in Vallaki, and became head of the new republic. He helped the party plan an escape route from their circus and kept them informed about the town.

people.name: Boondaego Spitecraft
people.who: Boondaego sold magical gear and later served as a rebellion general. At Krezk he helped the party fight Strahd and died after going back into the fight.

people.name: Baba Yaga
people.who: Baba Yaga rode a skeletal dragon over Berez and defended the fane there. After Korino reached the fane, the party saw Strahd behead her.

people.name: Burgomaster Boris
people.who: The burgomaster of Krezk welcomed the party to his manor and asked for help. The party later saw vampires attack him during the assault on the town.

people.name: The Abbot
people.who: The Abbot spoke of raising an army and needing further sacrifices. The party found him performing a ritual under the abbey and saw the Sunsword consume him after the fight.

people.name: Ezmerelda
people.who: The party found the monster hunter in Ravenloft's dungeon and later fought beside her. They learned that Rudolf raised her and that Roger was her brother.

people.name: Rudolf van Richten
people.who: The monster hunter keeps a trap-filled tower and disguises inventions as bananas. He gave the party equipment and explained how a physical link could bind a dark god to its chosen.

people.name: Godfrey Gwillim
people.who: A revenant knight who guided the party through Argynvostholt and fought beside them at the Amber Temple. The party learned that Alek was his brother.

people.name: Vladimir Horngaard
people.who: The revenant commander fought the party at Argynvostholt, then apologised after Argynvost appeared and gave them the Holy Symbol of Ravenkind. He later pledged that the knights would ride.

people.name: Argynvost
people.who: The silver dragon once defended the land against Strahd. His spirit spoke through the Sunsword and later appeared at Argynvostholt when the beacon was restored.

people.name: Azlan
people.who: Azlan told the party that he had taught Strahd magic and that his mind and body had been separated. The party freed him at Mount Baratok and watched him drive Strahd out of the mountain.

people.name: Vampyr
people.who: Azlan named Vampyr as the power behind Strahd. The party later saw Vampyr address and reprimand Strahd beside a pool of blood in the Amber Temple.

people.name: Nhazul
people.who: Nhazul answered Korino's wish beneath a black sun. Korino pledged his service after death, and the party saw Hrulek reform from ash and the darkness lift from Azza.

people.name: Dissipater
people.who: The party learned the devil's name after Hrulek drew Flames. A red portal stole Hrulek's bedroll and left a note.

places.name: Death House
places.what: A manor whose doors locked behind the party. Its crypts held the Durst family's remains and a flooded chamber where voices demanded a sacrifice.

places.name: Village of Barovia
places.what: The party investigated a missing cobbler here, met Ireena's family, and helped Ismark regain the burgomaster's mansion.

places.name: Blood of the Vine Tavern
places.what: The village tavern where Ismark and Vasili invited the party to talk and the party heard about local disappearances.

places.name: Barovia village church and graveyard
places.what: Red mud led the party to the graveyard. Zombies rose outside, and Donavich and Doru confronted them inside.

places.name: The blood pools
places.what: Shallow red water surrounded an island of bones where Strahd and Kolyan fought their duel.

places.name: Tser Pool Vistani camp
places.what: The Vistani brought the party here to meet Madam Eva, who read their cards and showed them a possible future.

places.name: Old Bonegrinder
places.what: The windmill where Morgantha and her daughters sold pies and nearly wiped out the party with lightning.

places.name: Vallaki
places.what: A walled town that enforced public cheer under the Valakovichs. After fighting and political upheaval, Elliot became head of the new republic.

places.name: St. Andral's Church
places.what: A Vallaki church that lost its protection after the theft of the saint's bones. The party later interrupted a hanging there.

places.name: Blue Water Inn
places.what: The Martikovs' inn, where the party heard the Keepers of the Feather's case for freeing Barovia.

places.name: Wachterhaus
places.what: Lady Fiona's family home. The party negotiated there, later fought spectral brides in its attic, and fled after a bedroom fire spread.

places.name: The Huntress's fane
places.what: A hill by werewolf caves where Azza restored the Huntress's protection during a fight with hags and werewolves.

places.name: Castle Ravenloft
places.what: Strahd's castle contains a theatre, dungeons, and crypts. Strahd told the party it could defend itself, and the party returned there as guests.

places.name: Ravenloft crypts
places.what: The party saw Zarr under Strahd's command here. They later reached Sergei's resting place, where the sword began to charge in his hand.

places.name: The winery and vineyard
places.what: The party found the winery under siege by vines and recovered a gem from the wine.

places.name: Berez
places.what: Flooded ruins where Baba Yaga rode a skeletal dragon over the swamp and Korino restored the fane beneath her.

places.name: Krezk
places.what: Burgomaster Boris welcomed the party here before their confrontation with the Abbot. The party later fled the town under attack from Strahd and his forces.

places.name: Abbey of Saint Markovia
places.what: The Abbot's church had stairs behind the altar leading to ritual chambers. The building began to collapse during the fight below.

places.name: Argynvostholt
places.what: The stronghold of the silver dragon's knights, where the party fought Vladimir and restored the beacon.

places.name: Rudolf van Richten's tower
places.what: A lakeside workshop defended by traps, running water, and an antimagic chamber. Lucy vanished into a clockwork gem in the laboratory.

places.name: Azlan's prison on Mount Baratok
places.what: A mountain prison that drained life to feed its undead. The party freed Azlan and defeated Escher there.

places.name: The Seeker's fane
places.what: A tree on a hill wrapped in black fog. The party found that speaking difficult truths let them move through it.

places.name: Tsolenka Pass
places.what: A snowy mountain route where ghosts warned the party about an illusory bridge and a giant vrock attacked in a blizzard.

places.name: Amber Temple
places.what: An amber complex where the party encountered shifting chambers, alternate selves, and merchants who took memories or years of life as payment.

places.name: Vampyr's tomb
places.what: A chamber deeper in the Amber Temple where the party found Hrulek bound and saw Strahd with Vampyr beside a pool of blood.

places.name: Sunsword Bar and Grill
places.what: A pub within the Sunsword where former wielders gathered. Zadkiel found Roger there and later learned that he himself was Sergei.

factions.name: Strahd's court
factions.what: Strahd's chamberlain, consorts, and servants enforced his rule. The party saw that individual consorts sometimes offered their own bargains.

factions.name: The Vistani
factions.what: Vistani travellers could pass through the mists. One group brought the party to Madam Eva and offered hospitality.

factions.name: Keepers of the Feather
factions.what: The Martikovs described a resistance network that wanted to free Barovia and had been watching the party.

factions.name: The Valakovichs
factions.what: Vallaki's ruling household held festivals and enforced public cheer, saying the celebrations kept Strahd away.

factions.name: House Wachter
factions.what: Lady Fiona's noble faction worked to remove the burgomaster. Fiona later pledged its resources to Vallaki's new republic.

factions.name: New Republic of Vallaki
factions.what: The settlement backed by the party put Elliot in charge of an independent Vallaki and bound Lady Fiona to provide support.

factions.name: Knights of Argynvostholt
factions.what: The silver dragon's knights remained as revenants after their deaths. After the beacon was restored, Vladimir offered their support against Strahd.

factions.name: Volenta's pack
factions.what: Werewolves who recognised Volenta as their alpha. The party fought the pack in the village and again near the fanes.

lore.what_we_learned: Kolyan said he separated the sunlight from the Sunsword and handed the blade to Strahd under their bargain over Ireena.
Rahadin said the dinner invitation guaranteed safe travel and hospitality while the party observed the house rules, including prohibitions on theft and violence.
The reading pointed to a tome in a house of governance, a holy symbol among fallen knights, a sword of sunlight linked to a throne room, and an ally who walked alone.
Inside the Tome, the party saw Rahadin train a young Strahd, Strahd's campaign against the silver dragon's knights, and Sergei's arrival at Ravenloft.
The party learned that the Huntress, Weaver, and Seeker were tied to sites from which Strahd drew power.
The gems held the gods' power and could be used to consecrate their fanes. The party also learned that Madam Eva was the Weaver.
In the Tome's memory, the party saw Strahd kill Sergei on his wedding day and saw Tatyana leap from a balcony after declaring her love for Sergei.

lore.topic: A dark god's link to its chosen
lore.what_we_learned: Rudolf explained that the connection could have a physical anchor and that breaking it could strip away immortality.
The fog gave way when the party spoke truths they wished were false. Hrulek's admission about his master brought him face to face with the Seeker.
The party found a market that charged in things like joy, memories, and years of life. Korino paid 36 years for the Time Stealer's Hourglass.
Nhazul offered to answer Korino's wish in exchange for service after death. Hrulek returned from ash and Azza felt the darkness carved out of him.
The party saw Vampyr reprimand Strahd beside a pool of blood, confirming that the two could speak face to face.
The Sunsword's former wielders told Zadkiel he was Sergei, and Alec remembered opening the pub with him.
